headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with hands-on experience in print production, brand collateral, and reusable visual systems.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, CorelDRAW, Framer, Webflow

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Print production, visual identity, typography, layout, print-ready file management, AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly)

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives spanning employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Managed print-ready file preparation including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Collaborated directly with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles across projects.
Leveraged AI-assisted workflows using ChatGPT and Adobe Firefly for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures tailored for startups and SMBs.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator to build product visuals and marketing assets.
Worked with developers and stakeholders to support design implementation.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that contributed to a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: AT Creation Startup Branding Kit
bullets: Developed a complete visual identity kit featuring logos, typography, and color palettes.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her graphic design experience at Ascent Business Solutions, emphasizing print production, collateral creation, and template-building that align with the brand execution needs at Boombay.
omitted: Bounceless case study and usability testing omitted as they are product UX artifacts less relevant to this pure graphic design role.
Wireframing, prototyping, and user flows omitted to keep the focus strictly on graphic and brand design.
